readmeExcerpt:
AI 是当今世界上最好的外语老师，Enjoy 做 AI 最好的助教。

--- ## 网页版 Enjoy 全新版本已经上线，可访问 [https://enjoy.bot](https://enjoy.bot) 直接使用。 ## 浏览器插件 Enjoy 浏览器插件已经上线，支持 YouTube 和 Netflix。可访问 [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/enjoy-echo/hiijpdndbjfnffibdhajdanjekbnalob) 安装使用。 --- ## 桌面版 新版桌面版将会是对网页版的套壳和增强，即将发布。 ## 相关阅读 ### 一千小时（2024） - [简要说明](https://1000h.org/intro.html) - [训练任务](https://1000h.org/training-tasks/kick-off.html) - [语音塑造](https://1000h.org/sounds-of-american-english/0-intro.html) - [大脑内部](https://1000h.org/in-the-brain/01-inifinite.html) - [自我训练](https://1000h.org/self-training/00-intro.html) ### 人人都能用英语（2010） - [简介](./book/README.md) - [第一章：起点](./book/chapter1.md) - [第二章：口语](./book/chapter2.md) - [第三章：语音](./book/chapter3.md) - [第四章：朗读](./book/chapter4.md) - [第五章：词典](./book/chapter5.md) - [第六章：语法](./book/chapter6.md) - [第七章：精读](./book/chapter7.md) - [第八章：叮嘱](./book/chapter8.md) - [后记](./book/end.md) ## 常见问题 请查询 [文档 FAQ](https://1000h.org/enjoy-app/faq.html)。

aiSummary.oneLiner: A comprehensive English learning system combining theoretical methodologies with an AI-powered practical assistant (Enjoy).
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Everyone Can Use English offers a structured approach to language acquisition, emphasizing that AI is the optimal foreign language teacher. It combines foundational learning methodologies detailed in related literature with a practical application called Enjoy, positioned as the ultimate AI teaching assistant. The project provides accessible tools, including a web platform and a dedicated browser extension for platforms like YouTube and Netflix, to immerse users in practical language use. It bridges the gap between traditional learning theories and modern AI-driven conversational practice and content consumption.
keyFeatures: AI Teaching Assistant: integrates an intelligent companion, Enjoy, to facilitate interactive and conversational English practice.
Browser Extension Integration: provides tools for seamless learning while consuming content on major media platforms like YouTube and Netflix.
Structured Learning Path: pairs practical tools with comprehensive theoretical guides covering phonetics, grammar, and reading comprehension.
Multi-Platform Accessibility: ensures the learning tools are available via a web interface, browser extensions, and an upcoming desktop application.
Contextual Immersion: allows users to practice language skills directly within their regular online media consumption habits.
Theoretical Foundation: deeply integrates the pedagogical principles from the '1000 Hours' and 'Everyone Can Use English' methodologies.

useCases.title: Immersive Media Learning
useCases.description: Used by language learners to study vocabulary and sentence structure while watching native English content on YouTube or Netflix.

useCases.title: Interactive Conversational Practice
useCases.description: Used by students to practice speaking and listening comprehension with the AI assistant, mimicking real-world dialogue.

useCases.title: Methodological Self-Study
useCases.description: Used by dedicated learners to follow a strict, thousands-hour training regimen based on comprehensive pedagogical guides.

useCases.title: Contextual Vocabulary Acquisition
useCases.description: Used by professionals to improve their English proficiency by analyzing real-world usage in media rather than isolated vocabulary lists.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This project is for dedicated English language learners seeking a modern, technology-driven approach to fluency. It is specifically aimed at Chinese speakers looking to overcome traditional educational barriers by leveraging AI and immersive media. Users should be motivated self-starters comfortable with installing browser extensions and following structured learning methodologies.
